messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up 1: opened quota request Q-12346 for us-east4 H100 increase (for a small Dedicated canary). Vendor "Sam-Vendor" posted a tentative manifest. Can we aim to land canary Tue 09:00 PT if racks arrive early? Tagging @Tina for provisional cost sign-off.

Raj: Can you paste the exact quota payload? I need the numbers to update infra/quotas.yml and author a TF PR.

Maria: Payload below. Also ran the region check locally.
```
provider: gcp
project: redwood-prod
region: us-east4
metric: NVIDIA_H100_GPUS
amount: 32
ticket: Q-12346
```
`gcloud compute regions describe us-east4 --project=redwood-prod --format='json(quotas)' | jq '.[] | select(.metric=="NVIDIA_H100_GPUS")'` returned current: 8, so this is +24.

OpsBot: Quota Q-12346 submitted 1: status=pending_vendor_ack. Please monitor vendor portal.

Sam-Vendor: We have Q-12346 tracked. Tentative staging timeline: Tue 05:30 PT - manifest assembled; transit ETA 07:45 PT; on-site rack install complete by 08:30 PT. Mix: 3 H100 blades (8 GPUs each across 2 racks) + 8 L40s (16GPUs/rack) for flexibility. Need confirmed install window and network handoff.

Kyle: FYI finance estimate for that footprint (reserved + burst) ~= $8.6k/mo. @Tina is that within Q2 burst cushion?

Tina: We can cover up to $10k/mo for short-lived canaries. Please keep a DA ticket with SKU-level costs and duration. Provisional spend approved.

Helen: If we land Tue morning, we should pre-stage autoscaler and reserved pool settings. Draft TF snippet below. Can someone review before Raj's PR?
```
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "canary-us-east4" {
  region = "us-east4"
  reserved_capacity = 24
  min_alive = 2
}
```
I want to avoid oversubscribe if vendor delivers more.

Raj: I'll open `infra/quotas.yml` + `infra/pools.tf` PR after I sync current limits. Will link here in ~30m.

Maria: Thanks. @Sam-Vendor please cc manifest once locked. If install finishes by 08:30 PT I'll kick canary at 09:00 PT and run a quick smoke test. :thumbsup:

Sam-Vendor: Will confirm manifest by EOD PST and post tracking.

Maria: Leaving thread for async updates. Raj, ping when PR is up and I'll queue the smoke. /cc @Helen
